Sakina Alvida Sakina Alvida

Shama Zindaan Main Main Manga Dai Koi

Aakhri Raat Hai Sakina Ki

Jarahi Hai Hussain Ki Beti

Aakhri Raat Hai Sakina Ki

Yeh Jo Gardan Pay Hai Rasan Ka Nishaa’n

Sath Turbat Main Is Kay Jaye Ga

Koi Umme Rubab Se Kehday

Ab Yeh Chehra Nazar Na Ayega

Aj Jee Bhar Kay Daikh Lo Bibi

Pass Baba Kay Jane Wali Hai

Ab Tamache Na Koi Maraiga

Qabr Main To Ghamo Ki Mari Kay

Koi Gohar Nahi Utare Ga

Jakai Turbat Main Chain Payegi

Hai Janab e Ameer Ki Poti

Inteha Is Pay Hai Ghareebi Ki

Aalam e Nazya Hogaya Tari

Sans Rukne Lagi Hai Bachi Ki

Raisma Ab To Khol Do Is Ki

Rone Wali Ki Chalti Sanso’n Ko

Aj Is Tarha Roka Jata Hai

Band Hojaye Shor Girya Ka

Sar e Shabbir Laya Jata Hai

Hai Mulaqat Baap Beti Ki

Shor Yeh Bairyon Ka Kehta Hai

Koi Uthta Hai Koi Girta Hai

Hai Khbr Yeh Ghareeb Bhai Koi

Dam Bhan Ka Nikalne Wala Hai

Abhi Laigi Yeh Aakhri Hichki

Rokay Sajjad Khud Say Kehtay Thay

Kaisay Mayat Uthaonga Is Ki

Qaid Zanjeer Main Hai Hath Mairay

Qabr Kaisay Banaonga Is Ki

Bai Kafan Jayegi Bhan Mairi

Kaisa Manzar Tha Qaid Main Akbar

Char Janib Tha Shor Girya Ka

Lakai Sajjad Nay Sakina Ki

Goud Main Sar Jo Rakha Baba Ka

Sar e Shabbir Say Sada Ayi

item.text:
Reconstructed all 40 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics` with sentence and proper-name capitalization. Updated the Urdu title and right-to-left metadata, removed `noUrdu`, and verified verse alignment.

The Roman readings `Raisma` and `Bhai Koi` are ambiguous. I rendered them phonetically as `ریسما` and `بھائی کوئی`.
